devin: quick bench ask — can someone run a lightweight smoke + profiling for opal-2b with adaptive batching enabled? need p50/p95 tokens/sec, tail latency (p99), and token-cost estimate for 1M tokens. KV cache ON, seq_len 512, batch sizes [1,4,8]. target: staging-gpu-rt3. ping if can't.
maria: i'll take this tonight on staging after 20:00 PT. what's the canonical prompt set to use?
devin: use bench/prompt_sets/conv-lite.json (16 warmup prompts). capture mem/allocs + kernel timings. if nvprof is flaky, at least grab cupti timeline.
ken: heads up — opal-2b sometimes evicts KV at batch 8 for seq>512, we've seen a tail blip. suggest also run batch=0 (no batching) baseline + batch=[1,4,8].
julia: config gist posted: https://gist.github.com/redwood/opal-2b-adaptive-bench
Run cmd:
```
bench-run --model opal-2b --seq 512 --prompts conv-lite.json --batches 1,4,8 --kv-cache on --warmup 16 --trace nvprof --out bench/output/opal-2b-adaptive
```
Add --no-batch for baseline.
sre-bot: Job 82017 queued by maria on staging-gpu-rt3

tao: quick publish of results to gcs://redwood-bench/opal-2b/adaptive/1712351234
Summary:
- batch=1: p50=12.1 tok/s, p95=14.8 tok/s, p99=24ms/token, mem=4.1GB, est cost for 1M tokens=$12.50
- batch=4: p50=38.5 tok/s, p95=42.0 tok/s, p99=18ms/token, mem=6.0GB, est cost for 1M tokens=$4.10
- batch=8: p50=62.0 tok/s, p95=65.3 tok/s, p99=120ms/token (spike), mem=9.4GB, est cost for 1M tokens=$2.60
Notes: batch=8 had a p99 spike on run #2, likely eviction/reclaim. Re-ran with preheat (warmup 64) results: p99=20ms/token, p95=66.0 tok/s.
maria: saw the same spike during run #2 — added preheat in re-run and kernel timings show a reclaim at t≈00:00:35. attaching alloc profile to the bench artifact.
ken: allocation deltas look like transient fragmentation on the allocator; filing a follow-up issue: https://redwood.internal/issue/INF-4523
devin: perfect — can you open a PR to add these numbers to the model-catalog and include the artifact link? also tag @product for cost estimate review.
maria: will open PR and include perf dashboard + raw traces under the artifact. assigning to @perf-team. :thumbsup:
